newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat calls clashes with Israel a "massacre".
newsitem.headline: Arafat calls clashes with Israel a "massacre".

text.p: President Yasser Arafat on Thursday called clashes with Israel in which more than 40 Palestinians have been killed "a real massacre against the Palestinian people".

He spoke to reporters while visiting wounded Palestinians at Shifa hospital in the Gaza Strip. "First of all what happened is a real massacre against the Palestinian people," he said. Israel Television said 11 Israelis were also killed in the clashes.
